title: Claude Code Reads OpenAI's File
caption:
Claude Code finally reads the file every other agent already reads.

2.1.277, shipped Sept 18. If there's no CLAUDE.md anywhere above your working directory, it loads AGENTS.md instead. The catch: a gitignored CLAUDE.local.md counts as a CLAUDE.md, so your teammate's agent can read the shared file while yours quietly doesn't.

My honest take — still a win, just a slow one. Anthropic donated MCP and OpenAI donated AGENTS.md to the same Linux Foundation body back in December. Nine months for Claude Code to read the other half.

Which file is in your repo?

items: AGENTS.md and no CLAUDE.md above you: Claude reads AGENTS.md

A CLAUDE.md holding an @AGENTS.md import: both load, once
